about: POINT-CONFIRMED parks: an official POINT record with the park's name within 0.5 km of the POTA pin. kind point-circle-100ft is a 30.48 m circle around the official agency point (the POTA pin is never moved). It is a stand-in used only by the 2-fer bot as the labelled point-circle tier; never an official boundary, never a key outline. Replaced automatically when a real boundary is found. Every card for these parks notes the 100 ft circle.
